title: PAH-OMC-020 fixed owner-search snapshot successor
question: Can the dynamic R-526/N2a owner-packet absence audit be replaced by a fixed manifest that remains byte-replayable after later proof files are added?
finding: Yes as a provenance repair. An 84-file marker manifest and its parent hashes replay without rescanning the changing worktree; the N2a v1.1 successor pins the current N2b bytes and the snapshot. Both snapshot-time authorization and completion sets are empty. This remains an evidence hold because no source-authorized U_n/common-space packet is supplied.
decision_reason: The successor removes a reproducibility defect without editing R-526, the v1.0 N2a contract or R-527. It turns the next owner search into a versioned snapshot/reopen protocol, so a later candidate is detected explicitly rather than silently changing a prior PASS.
boundary: PAH-001, PAH-OMC-020, original functional/rates/state, external Markov time and j-before-n order are frozen. The snapshot is repository provenance only; no U_n, semigroup, process or physical interpretation is constructed.
method: Freeze the marker-bearing strategy/pa-hyp candidate manifest and each byte SHA-256 in PAH-OMC-020-owner-search-snapshot-v1.json.
Pin the current PAH-001, preregistration, N2a v1, N2b result, R-525, R-526 and R-527 parent hashes.
Create the N2a v1.1 intake successor with the nine unchanged owner-payload requirements and the fixed snapshot hash.
Replay primary, non-importing independent, hostile and integrated checks; keep hashing-only provenance separate from analytic Lean claims.
next_action: Use --detect-new on the frozen snapshot at the next owner-input checkpoint; if a source-authorized packet appears, hash-pin it and test N2a--N2d once under the unchanged PAH-OMC-020 quantifiers.
revisit_condition: Reopen on a source-authorized owner packet, any new candidate reported by --detect-new, or any parent-byte change. Do not rewrite prior snapshot or result records.
non_claims: No PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence, common-space theorem, Mosco result or R-512 minimal-form identification.
No universal impossibility follows from the empty snapshot marker set.
No PAH-001 functional, rate, state, carrier, regulator, time or limit-order change.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
